item.title: Some advice to the president
item.description: Editor, The Beacon: Don’t try to rescue the Iranian people from the mullahs. Yes, you are on a roll with the successful Maduro snatch. And it is tempting: to be an acclaimed savior, to turn the terrorist into an ally, and to limit China’s access to oil. item.title: Trump presides over a lawless regime
item.description: Editor, The Beacon: “Obey the law and there won’t be a problem” was the headline in David Rauschenberger’s recent column in The Beacon. It would be nice if Trump would heed your advice. His entire regime is lawless, and you defend that? They are shielding pedophiles and demonizing people who don’t look like you and me. item.title: Checks and balances are necessary

item.title: Can Volusia County be the roundabout capital of Florida?
item.description: Roundabouts are no longer a novelty in Volusia County. They are becoming part of our daily commute. Anyone who drives through DeLand has seen it firsthand. item.title: PHOTOS: DeLand Unleashed
item.description: Downtown DeLand went to the dogs Saturday as costumed pups, decorated floats and enthusiastic owners filled the streets for the annual DeLand Dog Parade. item.title: Deltona Regional Library to Temporarily Close for Facility Improvements
item.description: Volusia County Public Library announces that Deltona Regional Library will be closed Monday, February 23, through Saturday, March 14, to allow for scheduled facility improvement projects. item.description: Two graduates of Volusia County Schools were recognized for their leadership and service during the Office of Will Roberts – Tax Collector’s annual team member recognition ceremony Feb. 16. item.title: Post 187 continues its mission to preserve Black veterans’ legacy
item.description: After World War II, African American veterans returned home hoping for the rights and opportunities they had fought to defend. Instead, many found the same segregation and discrimination they had left behind. In DeLand, that reality became clear when Black veterans tried to join their local American Legion. According to post leaders, they were not allowed to join Post 5. […] The post Post 187 continues its mission to preserve Black veterans’ legacy first appeared on The West Volusia Beacon.
